description: Community resources for The Isle (Evrima) servers, shown by 'isle-server plugins community' and the web UI. These are third-party projects: they are listed for convenience, not installed, reviewed or endorsed. Links were checked when they were added (2026-11).
mods: Evrima has no official mod or Steam Workshop support. Server-side modding (UE4SS, .pak) is niche, unofficial and can break with every game update; community mods are shared through Discord servers, forums and GitHub. Use the plugin manager's catalogs and 'install <url>#sha256=...' for anything you download, so the file you run is the file you checked.
catalog_help: A catalog is a JSON file over HTTPS with the same format as plugins/catalog.json. Add one with 'isle-server plugins sources add <https-url>' or on the Plugins page of the web UI. Entries that download code must carry a sha256.
